mapper.sql: id, event_id, event_title, event_type, event_summary, first_publish_time, discover_time, risk_level, impact_scope, involved_department_id, current_heat, event_status, disposal_requirement, archive_conclusion, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE campus_event SET risk_level = #{riskLevel}, disposal_requirement = #{disposalRequirement}, event_status = 'rated', update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM campus_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT e.event_title as title, e.create_time as time, COALESCE(c.source_platform, '新浪微博') as media FROM campus_event e LEFT JOIN campus_event_clue ec ON e.event_id = ec.event_id LEFT JOIN campus_clue c ON ec.clue_id = c.clue_id WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId} LIMIT 1
